levels.surface: يزيد بن خالد بن عبد الله بن موهب الهمداني

notes: «- يعني ابن فضالة المصري -» is an editor's gloss and is left out.
«مسلمة بن مخلد» appoints Ruwayfi', an action described (rule 6), so he is not a link; Ruwayfi' is the last link as the one who relates the Prophet's words («ثم قال قال لي رسول الله»).

fixes.reason: K6I ends the chain at Maslama ibn Makhlad, who only appoints Ruwayfi' in the text; the chain runs through Shayban to Ruwayfi', who relates the Prophet's words.

evidence.quote: إن مسلمة بن مخلد استعمل رويفع بن ثابت
